 Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur.
 KATHMANDU: Cricket fans are in for an exciting double-header today as four teams take the field in two crucial matches of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur.
 In the first match, scheduled to begin at 12:30 pm, Lumbini Lions will face Janakpur Bolts.
 Lumbini Lions, who remain unbeaten in the tournament, have won two of their three matches, while one ended in a tie. With five points, they currently sit at the top of the points table and will be aiming to secure their third win.
 Janakpur Bolts, meanwhile, have collected four points from four matches, winning two and losing two. They are currently fourth in the standings, behind Karnali and Biratnagar on net run rate. Janakpur will be looking for their third victory in their fifth match of the tournament. The second match of the day will see Kathmandu Gorkhaz take on Biratnagar Kings at 5 pm.
 Kathmandu, who have won one and lost one in their two matches so far, will be targeting their second victory. Currently placed second from the bottom of the points table with two points, the team will be under pressure to improve its position.
 Biratnagar Kings, on the other hand, have won two of their four matches and are currently second in the standings with four points. Led by captain Sandeep Lamichhane, Biratnagar will be looking to register their third victory in their fifth match of the tournament.
